scope: Clean-room follow-up using NVIDIA-authored interface definitions, the installed driver, public release documentation, and a bounded root-run experiment. No proprietary mVolt code or binaries were used.

tested_configuration.limitation: One tested configuration and operating point; no board or driver compatibility gate follows.

status: Arbitrary six-word voltage request replay remains unresolved. No new live equation or voltage-offset control is exposed.

new_public_lead.claim: The release describes an experimental voltage-offset BIOS override enabled after a GPU restart.
new_public_lead.limit: The public description does not establish its implementation or a way to clear the independently traced PERF offset-copy suppression flag.

static_findings: The confirmed PERF+0x32C constructor assignment comes from the GPU HAL index. The bounded follow-up found no proven BIOS or registry control for that flag.
The two recognized BIOS rail subtype paths converge on the same gated six-word row setter. Changing subtype alone is not an established bypass.

NVIDIA's NVOC exported-method record stores its function pointer 0x10 bytes before methodId. Equation SET 0x2080E0B7 uses handler 0x4CE4C0; variable SET 0x2080E0B4 uses 0x4CE910 in this inspected image.

Equation SET selects existing rows in the same 8192-entry, 0x80-byte-row geometry returned by the independent CONTROL getter. The traced row path can write bounds before a later error, and the group may repeat its internal update. A successful status is insufficient.
The equation handler's post-call through PERF+0x588 remains unnamed. No physical-voltage or firmware-consumer conclusion is drawn.

experiment.operation: Unchanged selected REL equation row; no bound, coefficient, BIOS or registry change requested

difference.field: Evaluated frequency word in V/F curve entries

interpretation: An accepted unchanged-row SET with exact equation cache readback does not guarantee an unchanged evaluated V/F curve. The captured pair does not identify the cause. This experiment does not establish writable changed bounds, mVolt's implementation, voltage-offset enablement, or restoration of arbitrary legacy rail requests.
next_required_evidence: Identify the post-SET recomputation path and explain or independently bound its evaluated-curve effects before exposing live equation writes.
Find and verify an actual independently understood voltage-offset enabling mechanism or alternative request path; do not invent a BIOS toggle from a public feature name.
For any changing-offset capability, verify all six actual request words and peers, and restore original requests while that capability is still active before reverting its enabling state.
